bergamot-translator-worker.js and bergamot-translator-worker.wasm are the WebAssembly build of
bergamot-translator v0.4.5 (the offline translator Firefox uses), from the npm package
@browsermt/bergamot-translator 0.4.9, unchanged.

Source: https://github.com/browsermt/bergamot-translator
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/)

The translation models are not included: Cadenza downloads them from Mozilla
(firefox-settings-attachments.cdn.mozilla.net) the first time you translate from or into a language.
Each model comes with its own license, listed at https://github.com/mozilla/firefox-translations-models
